content.value_statement: Skill authors need a repeatable process for turning workflows into useful AI skills. This skill provides clear steps for examples, resource planning, metadata, packaging, and iteration.
actual_capabilities: Explains the required structure of a skill package and SKILL.md file.
Guides authors through collecting examples before writing skill instructions.
Helps decide when to use scripts, references, or assets as bundled resources.
Provides guidance for writing concise metadata and instructional skill content.
Shows how to initialize and package a skill with validation scripts.
Describes an iteration workflow for improving skills after real use.
limitations: It provides guidance, not an executable skill creation tool by itself.
It references helper scripts but does not include them in this package.
It does not validate generated skills unless external packaging scripts are available.
It focuses on Claude skill design rather than general plugin development.

use_cases.title: Design a new domain skill
use_cases.description: Turn repeated domain work into a structured skill with clear triggers, workflows, and supporting resources.

use_cases.title: Improve an existing skill
use_cases.description: Review a current skill for metadata quality, resource organization, and progressive disclosure.

use_cases.title: Package reusable team knowledge
use_cases.description: Organize scripts, references, and assets so another Claude instance can perform specialized work consistently.

prompt_templates.title: Create a simple skill plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner author starting a new skill.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me plan a new Claude skill for [task]. Ask only the most important questions first, then suggest the SKILL.md structure and resources.

prompt_templates.title: Convert examples into resources
prompt_templates.scenario: Author has sample user requests and needs reusable assets.
prompt_templates.prompt: Here are example requests for a skill: [examples]. Identify which scripts, references, and assets should be included, and explain why.

prompt_templates.title: Review skill metadata
prompt_templates.scenario: Author wants better automatic skill activation.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this skill name and description for activation quality: [metadata]. Make it concise, specific, and third-person.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a complete skill package
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced author preparing a skill for distribution.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this skill package outline: [outline]. Check progressive disclosure, resource placement, SKILL.md length, packaging readiness, and iteration risks.

output_examples.input: I want a skill that helps with monthly finance reports.
output_examples.output: A useful result would define the target report workflow, identify reusable finance schema references, and recommend concise SKILL.md instructions.

output_examples.input: My SKILL.md is too long and includes many examples.
output_examples.output: A useful result would move detailed examples into reference files and keep only essential activation and workflow guidance in SKILL.md.

output_examples.input: I need to package a skill for another Claude instance.
output_examples.output: A useful result would check metadata, file organization, optional scripts, references, assets, validation steps, and packaging readiness.

best_practices: Start with concrete user examples before writing the final skill instructions.
Keep SKILL.md concise and move detailed material into referenced resources.
Use scripts only when repeatability or deterministic execution is important.
anti_patterns: Do not place all domain knowledge directly in SKILL.md when references would work better.
Do not write vague metadata that prevents automatic skill activation.
Do not keep generated example files that are not needed by the final skill.

faq.question: What problem does this skill solve?
faq.answer: It helps authors create structured Claude skills that are easier to trigger, maintain, and package.

faq.question: Does it create files automatically?
faq.answer: No. It explains when to use initialization and packaging scripts, but this package only contains guidance.

faq.question: Who should use this skill?
faq.answer: Use it when designing a new Claude skill or improving an existing one for repeated workflows.

faq.question: What are bundled resources?
faq.answer: They are optional scripts, references, and assets that support the main SKILL.md instructions.

faq.question: Why keep SKILL.md short?
faq.answer: A short SKILL.md supports progressive disclosure and avoids loading unnecessary details into context.

faq.question: Can this help with skill packaging?
faq.answer: Yes. It describes validation and packaging steps that prepare a skill for distribution.
